name: Yolvex Unit 43 Original
description: This listing is an infrasound pressure-reference cell listed with accuracy class 1.14 percent, operating temperature -16 degrees Celsius, sampling rate 449.2 hertz. Its remaining stated figures are calibration interval 49 months, unit price set after acceptance, mounting tripod. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
